title: The Stratified Mathlib 4 Sheaf and Cycle Interface Gate: Formulating the Universal Cycle Class Map and Upstream Mathlib Integration
description: Formal Lean 4 machine-certified proof and numerical verification of the Stratified Mathlib 4 Sheaf and Cycle Interface Gate, formulating categorical interfaces for projective varieties, Chow groups, and the universal cycle class map. In this work, ai is being used as a tool to assist in formal verification, symbol auditing, and manuscript preparation.
